planets.name: K2-28 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-28 with a 2.26-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-28 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-28. Its orbit and size follow Hirano et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
